def client(host=RESTAPI_SERVER_HOST, port=RESTAPI_SERVER_PORT):
    """
    REST-JSON API client
    """
    addr = "http://%s:%d" % (host, port)
    logger.info("Starting REST-JSON API client to '%s'..." % addr)

    import requests

    # Example of using requests instead of curl
    try:
        response = requests.post(f"{addr}/task/new")
        taskid = response.json().get('taskid')
        logger.info(f"Task ID: {taskid}")

        scan_response = requests.post(f"{addr}/scan/{taskid}/start", json={"url": "http://testphp.vulnweb.com/artists.php?artist=1"})
        logger.info(f"Scan started: {scan_response.status_code}")

        data_response = requests.get(f"{addr}/scan/{taskid}/data")
        logger.info(f"Scan data: {data_response.json()}")

        log_response = requests.get(f"{addr}/scan/{taskid}/log")
        logger.info(f"Scan log: {log_response.text}")
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"An error occurred: {e}")
